stellantis-reorganises-design-department.title_en: STELLANTIS REORGANISES DESIGN DEPARTMENT FOR CITROËN, DS AND OPEL

Sandeep Bhambra is the new Head of Design for Citroën and DS Automobiles, while Pierre Leclercq becomes Head of Design for Opel and Vauxhall. These are the two appointments through which Stellantis is strengthening its design organisation in Europe, effective 2 November 2026. Bhambra succeeds Pierre Leclercq at Citroën and Thierry Metroz at DS Automobiles. Changan’s premium brand is using the occasion to launch its strategy for Europe, starting, rather curiously, with Spain and Norway, with two models and a new concept car, the Avatr T09. Reinterpreting it without compromising its identity was the challenge JAS Motorsport entrusted to Pininfarina. As JAS CEO Alessandro Mariani recalled, the Italian design house embraced the original vision, making it its own and enriching it throughout the development process. gfg-style-peralta-d-the-history-lies-in-.title_en: GFG STYLE PERALTA D, THE HISTORY LIES IN THE DETAILS
gfg-style-peralta-d-the-history-lies-in-.excerpt: A monolith of hand-hammered copper on Maserati GranTurismo mechanicals. This is the Peralta D, a one-off designed by Fabrizio Giugiaro with GFG Style for Mexican collector Carlos Peralta and unveiled at the Pastejé Automotive Invitational in Mexico. After the 2025 Peralta S, dedicated to his sons, the D is dedicated to his daughters, and carries the language of the first car into a 2+2 Gran Turismo coupé. The design plays on the contrast between two materials. Below the beltline the body is entirely copper; above it, the glasshouse is mirrored glass, treated to reproduce the metal’s warm tone.

The proportions are bolder and the surfacing more expressive, but the foundation is unchanged: glossy, sculpted, porcelain-inspired volumes and fluid lines that seek a balance between strength and refinement. But as electric cars deliver increasingly similar levels of thrust, the spec sheet no longer makes the difference, and the question changes: how do you measure what performance makes you feel? eterea-911-iperleggera-on-show-in-turin.title_en: ETEREA 911 IPERLEGGERA ON SHOW IN TURIN
